Rarity.rationale: StoneHumidifier.cs:14 is RelicRarity.Ancient. EXECUTED (b15-pool): absent from the grab bag, granted by the ported Neow event (events/neow.py).

AfterRestSiteHeal.issue: Rollup of guard G1 per binding rule 4. The effect and its amount are exactly right; the dispatch is missing one of the hook's two C# call sites.

ModifyExtraRestSiteHealText.rationale: StoneHumidifier.cs:27-42 appends base.AdditionalRestSiteHealText to the rest-site button's extra text and gates on LocalContext.IsMe(Owner) -- a localisation/UI string for the local player only. It changes no game state. Waived under the shared contract's presentation exclusion (and under its multiplayer exclusion for the LocalContext gate), not under an unreachability claim. Noted in .superpowers/sdd/content-relic-sweeps.md's sweep C as one of the hooks with no Relic base method at all, which is consistent: there is nothing for it to do.

guards.what: G1 (DORMANT): Hook.AfterRestSiteHeal has TWO dispatch sites in C# and the sim ports only one
guards.issue: MECHANISM: an executed grep for AfterRestSiteHeal over the decompiled source finds two callers outside the relic models -- HealRestSiteOption.cs:109 (`isMimicked` forwarded from the option) and MendRestSiteOption.cs:135 (`isMimicked: false`). RunState.rest_heal (run.py:1089-1095) is the port of the first only; there is no Mend path in the sim at all. So a Mend that heals a player would grant +5 Max HP in the game and nothing in the sim. This is PROMPT.md bug class 20's shape -- the right hook, dispatched from too few SITES -- rather than a wrong slot. REACHABILITY (DORMANT): `MendRestSiteOption` is a multiplayer rest-site action (it heals a TARGET player, MendRestSiteOption.cs:135 passes `target.RunState`), and grep over sts2_rl/ for a mend rest-site option returns nothing -- rest_site.py's RestSiteOption set has no Mend. The concrete unported thing is MendRestSiteOption itself; because it is multiplayer-shaped its absence may well be a permanent scope exclusion, but it is filed as a dormant gap and not a waiver because the divergence is a missing dispatch site, not a multiplayer parameter (binding rule 1). Rule 7: leans on run.py and sts2_rl/rest_site.py, neither hashed here.

guards.what: N1: `player == base.Owner` (StoneHumidifier.cs:20) and the isMimicked parameter (StoneHumidifier.cs:18), both absent from the port
guards.rationale: The owner check is a multiplayer filter (Hook.AfterRestSiteHeal is dispatched over the whole run's listeners, so a relic must not react to another player's heal); RunState.rest_heal walks only its own run's relics. The isMimicked flag is likewise multiplayer/UI plumbing -- StoneHumidifier itself IGNORES it, so even in C# it changes nothing here. Waived as multiplayer-only under the shared contract's global scope, not under an unreachability claim.

guards.what: N2: MaxHpVar(5m) read as BaseValue (StoneHumidifier.cs:16, 23) and CreatureCmd.GainMaxHp's heal side effect
guards.rationale: No AscensionHelper.GetValueIfAscension in the file, so 5 is the pinned non-ascension value and stone_humidifier.py:13's MAX_HP = 5 is right. CreatureCmd.GainMaxHp (CreatureCmd.cs:786-799) raises max HP and then Heals by the SAME amount, which run.gain_max_hp mirrors exactly (run.py:311-314, citing the same source). EXECUTED (py audit/tools/relic_probes_b15.py b15-misc): a 40/80 player takes the rest heal for 24 (30% of 80, truncated) and finishes at 69/85 -- 64 after the heal, then +5 max and +5 current. ORDER checked deliberately: C# fires the hook AFTER the option's own heal (HealRestSiteOption.cs:109) and the sim does the same (run.py:1092 heals, then :1093-1094 dispatches), which matters because the +5 heal would be capped away if the +5 max HP arrived first.

guards.what: N3: no undo_after_obtained, although the relic raises Max HP
guards.rationale: PROMPT.md v6 item 3 (rule-3 resolution): the ABSENCE of undo_after_obtained is faithful at every site -- the helper has no C# counterpart (nothing in the game un-picks a relic), so a sim lacking it is not diverging from the source, which is the only question this audit asks. Distinct from the mango/strawberry family for a second reason as well: this relic's Max HP is granted at a REST SITE, not on pickup, so undo_after_obtained could not unwind it even if it existed -- the conformance runner's relic swap happens at the offering node, before any rest site the relic would act on. Recorded so a future reader does not add it by analogy with relic/strawberry.

The sim has no relic UI. Waived under the shared contract's presentation/animation exclusion, not under an unreachability claim.
